name: pensive
label: Pensive
description: The crew's memory as a constellation you can turn: every memory, the bot and project and kind it belongs to, and the retrieval index behind them, with the connections drawn. Drag empty space to rotate, drag a node to move it, double-click to let go, wheel to zoom, click a node to read it. Reads memories.db, crew.json and the RAG index; stores nothing.
